sentences.text: Teen Wolf is an American television series developed by Jeff Davis for MTV .	Jeff Davis	Jeff Davis (writer)	Teen Wolf	Teen Wolf	MTV	MTV

It is loosely based on the 1985 film of the same name , and stars Tyler Posey as a teenager named Scott McCall , who is bitten by a werewolf and must cope with how it affects his life and the lives of those closest to him , and Dylan O'Brien as `` Stiles '' Stilinski , Scott 's best friend .	Tyler Posey	Tyler Posey	Dylan O'Brien	Dylan O'Brien	1985 film of the same name	Teen Wolf	werewolf	werewolf
The series has received generally positive reviews from critics and is a fan favorite on social media .	social media	social media
Teen Wolf premiered on June 5 , 2011 , following the 2011 MTV Movie Awards .	Teen Wolf	Teen Wolf	MTV	MTV	2011 MTV Movie Awards	2011 MTV Movie Awards
On July 9 , 2015 , Teen Wolf was renewed for a sixth season of 20 episodes , which premiered on November 15 , 2016 .	Teen Wolf	Teen Wolf
On July 21 , 2016 , the cast announced at Comic Con that the sixth season would be the series ' final .	Comic Con	San Diego Comic-Con International
